notes: NHTSA crash test 15759, a 2025 Volkswagen Golf GTI struck on the left (driver) side by a moving barrier. Cut per docs/DATA_HUNT.md 3.4 with scripts/pseudo_pair.py: before is 32 to 52 s of the documentation video (left side, rear, right side, front, then half a second of the interior), after is 112 to 142 s (rear-left corner with the barrier, the left side, a placard close-up, the left side square on, front, rear, then the interior). The left doors changed; the rest of what both walks show did not. The yellow and black tape grid and the placards are on the car in both walks and are not marks; the PRE-TEST and POST-TEST placards differ, and that must not come back as new damage.
